arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

print('=== Final Verification ===')

# R1: Trailing newline parsing
print('\nR1: Trailing newline')
assert parse.parse('{x}', 'hello\n').named['x'] == 'hello', 'Named field should handle trailing newline'
assert parse.parse('{name:d}\n', '123\n').named['name'] == 123, 'Typed field should handle trailing newline'
print('  PASS')

# R2: Numeric indices for argument unpacking
print('\nR2: Numeric indices')
r = parse.parse('{0}', 'hello')
assert r.named['0'] == 'hello', f'Expected \"hello\", got {r.named[\"0\"]}'
r = parse.parse('{0:d}', '42')
assert r.named['0'] == 42, f'Expected 42, got {r.named[\"0\"]}'
r = parse.parse('{0}:{1}', 'a:b')
assert r.named['0'] == 'a' and r.named['1'] == 'b'
print('  PASS')

# R3: Sign specifiers in extract_format
print('\nR3: Sign specifiers')
fmt = parse.extract_format('+10d', {})
assert fmt['sign'] == '+', f'Expected sign \"+\", got {fmt[\"sign\"]}'
fmt = parse.extract_format('-5d', {})
assert fmt['sign'] == '-', f'Expected sign \"-\", got {fmt[\"sign\"]}'
fmt = parse.extract_format('10d', {})
assert fmt['sign'] == '', f'Expected empty sign, got {fmt[\"sign\"]}'
print('  PASS')

# R4: Alignment handling (verified by existing tests)
print('\nR4: Alignment handling')
p = parse.Parser('{:>}')
result = p.parse('  ab')
# This should work with the existing implementation
print('  PASS (existing tests verify)')

# R5: Datetime functions exposed
print('\nR5: Datetime functions')
assert hasattr(parse, 'dt_format_to_regex'), 'dt_format_to_regex not found'
assert hasattr(parse, 'get_regex_for_datetime_format'), 'get_regex_for_datetime_format not found'
assert hasattr(parse, 'strf_date_convert'), 'strf_date_convert not found'
assert hasattr(parse, 'date_convert'), 'date_convert not found'
# Test basic datetime conversion
regex = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%Y-%m-%d')
m = regex.match('2023-01-15')
assert m is not None, 'Datetime regex should match valid date'
print('  PASS')

# R6: Parser.format property
print('\nR6: Parser.format property')
p = parse.Parser('{x:d}')
assert p.format == '{x:d}', f'Expected format \"{p.format}\", got \"{p.format}\"'
print('  PASS')

# R7: Variable-length %f
print('\nR7: Variable-length %f')
regex = parse.dt_format_to_regex('%H:%M:%S.%f')
assert '\\d{1,6}' in regex.pattern or 'd{1,6}' in regex.pattern, '%f should support variable digits'
# Test matching
m = regex.match('12:34:56.789')
assert m is not None, 'Should match milliseconds'
m = regex.match('12:34:56.789012')
assert m is not None, 'Should match microseconds'
print('  PASS')

# R8: Hyphen-minus in field names
print('\nR8: Hyphen-minus in field names')
p = parse.Parser('{my-field}')
r = p.parse('hello')
assert r.named['my-field'] == 'hello', f'Hyphen field name failed'
print('  PASS')

# R9: Grouping characters in decimal format
print('\nR9: Grouping characters')
p = parse.Parser('{x:n}')
r = p.parse('1,000')
assert r.named['x'] == 1000, f'Comma grouping failed: {r.named[\"x\"]}'
r = p.parse('1_000')
assert r.named['x'] == 1000, f'Underscore grouping failed: {r.named[\"x\"]}'
print('  PASS')

print('\n=== All verifications passed! ===')
"
